facts.fact: A 2026 study found that 26.4% of US CTV ad buyers cite accessing precision targeting not available in linear TV as one of their top priorities for CTV advertising.

facts.quote: Because CTV ads are delivered through internet-connected streaming devices, which can be linked to households using signals such as IP addresses

facts.quote: This data is matched to households through StackAdapt’s internal identity graph, which connects IP addresses, device IDs, and other pseudonymous identifiers

facts.quote: StackAdapt’s proprietary Interest & Intent segments, which capture users’ behaviors and intent signals across devices

facts.fact: The page states that a key consideration for geographic targeting is that greater geographic precision can sometimes reduce audience size and available inventory.

facts.quote: Requires usable first-party data and may be more limited in some regions

facts.quote: while 10.3% use behavioral targeting to reach viewers more effectively

facts.fact: Geographic targeting in CTV can go from countries, states, or provinces down to cities, designated market areas, and ZIP or postal codes.
facts.quote: whether that’s broad regions, like countries, states, or provinces, down to more specific locations, like cities, designated market areas, and even ZIP or postal codes

facts.fact: Smaller geographic targeting areas mean fewer households and available impressions, which can limit reach and make budget spend less efficient.
facts.quote: The smaller the geographic area, the fewer households and available impressions you may have to work with—limiting reach and making it harder to spend your budget efficiently.

facts.fact: Privacy regulations such as GDPR limit first-party data targeting options in certain regions, such as parts of EMEA, so advertisers should confirm available targeting options in their market.
facts.quote: first-party data targeting can be more limited in certain regions, like parts of EMEA, where privacy regulations like GDPR place stricter requirements

facts.fact: CTV platforms can use household IP addresses to determine whether a viewer falls within a targeted geographic area.
facts.quote: CTV advertising platforms can use household IP addresses to determine whether a viewer falls within a targeted area

facts.fact: Demographic targeting in CTV can use age, gender, household income, or family composition.
facts.quote: Demographic targeting focuses on broad audience characteristics, such as age, gender, household income, or family composition.

facts.fact: Lookalike audience targeting uses an existing audience, such as website visitors captured through a pixel, to find new users with similar behaviors or characteristics.
facts.quote: lookalike audience targeting uses an existing audience, such as website visitors captured through a pixel placed on your website, to find new users with similar behaviors or characteristics
